items.title: Carolyn Buck Interview, 1969-03-25
items.q: he's the most wonderful person I've ever met... I mean, his playing to me naturally will always be the greatest thing. He's always been my idol since I've been a child. And for me to come in contact, as I had with him... And then to know him as I had known him.

ctx.x: And he said, I don't know. Do you remember anything else about the last, say that last three month period or anything that's particularly memorable or anything in conclusion that the 73 sisters would like to say about George or remembering anything you remember especially?

Oh, not really, Tom. All I can think of is that he's the most wonderful person I've ever met. I mean, his playing to me naturally will always be the greatest thing. He's always been my idol since I've been a child. And for me to come in contact, as I had with him, with an idol, which was like some teenagers go after movie stars, he was mine.
